correctness.rationale: The polygonal secondary polytope is a (p−3)-dimensional convex associahedron and the cyclic action permutes its area-coordinate vertices. Triangle-area incidence gives fixed affine constraints on the sum and first cosine/sine harmonics. Dimension implies its translation representation is exactly W_p=R^p minus Fourier modes 0 and 1. Choose an invariant interior center and take polar dual; radial projection is a C_p-equivariant homeomorphism of the simplicial boundary to the unit sphere S(W_p). Its real Fourier summands are weights 2,...,(p−1)/2; all are nonzero modulo prime p, making the sphere action free and exactly the specified weighted lens quotient. Classical lens-space cellular chain yields Z/p in each lower odd degree and top Z for p≥7. The p=5 dimension-one quotient is S1 with π1=Z, correctly excepted. Independent noncrossing simplex orbit enumerations returned p5 (5→1,5→1) and p7 (14→2,56→8,84→12,42→6) across dimensions. Finite face checks do not alone imply homeomorphism for all primes.

value.rationale: Classifies the complete topological homeomorphism type of a canonical prime cyclic quotient of the natural type-A associahedral sphere, including precise lens weights and integral torsion. The exact missing first Fourier mode distinguishes it from the well-studied cyclohedron; it is a motivated topology result rather than merely quoting known lens homology.

final_claim: For every odd prime p≥5, the polygonal noncrossing-diagonal associahedral sphere modulo full p-rotation is homeomorphic to weighted lens space L(p;2,3,...,(p−1)/2); p=5 quotient is a circle and p≥7 has π1=Cp and explicit Z/p odd-degree homology.
limitations: Odd prime p≥5 only; p=5 fundamental group is Z, not C5. Composite p and reflection quotients not claimed.
